$comment: Single source of truth for every module that ships in the conxa-app zip
(the disk-resident app layer). Consumed by BOTH build pipelines so their
file lists can never drift again:
Source layout: app-layer modules live in runtime/app/. bootstrap.js is NOT
listed — it runs only from inside the host exe (pkg-bundled); nothing on
disk ever loads a conxa-app/ copy of it.
Obfuscation profiles (must stay in lockstep between both consumers):
default           — full protection: self-defending + rc4 string-array
in-page           — page_scripts.js holds functions Playwright serializes
into the BROWSER page realm; string-array/self-defending
inject a module-scope decoder var that does not exist
once the source is re-parsed there, breaking those
functions at runtime. Mangled identifiers are safe

files.name: env.js
files._note: server/browser/run/auth_manager fall back to this when global.__conxaEnv is absent (standalone dev mode: node server.js).

files.name: host_bridge.js
files._note: Centralized host-globals accessors (__hostRequire etc.) — required by config_edit/sync/manifest_manager/server/run/browser/auth_manager.

files.name: cli_installer.js
files._note: Extracted from server.js: CLI installer mode.

files.name: recovery_park.js
files._note: Extracted from server.js: parked-recovery state, keyed per skill (RT-3).

files.name: run_registry.js
files._note: Extracted from server.js: multi-run execution registry (RT-3) — replaces the old single activeExecution slot.

files.name: host_lock.js
files._note: Per-external-host mutual exclusion (RT-3 follow-up) — serializes only runs that overlap on the same target platform.

files.name: target_hosts.js
files._note: Extracted from server.js: resolveTargetHosts — every required app's host per run, feeding host_lock.js; pure so the multi-app union stays unit-testable.

files.name: failure_response.js
files._note: Extracted from server.js: Tier 3/4 failure-payload assembly.

files.name: tool_defs.js
files._note: Extracted from server.js: static MCP tool definitions.

files.name: run_config.js
files._note: Extracted from run.js seams: env-tunable constants.

files.name: recovery_log.js
files._note: Extracted from run.js seams: durable recovery log.

files.name: interpolate.js
files._note: Extracted from run.js seams: input interpolation.

files.name: resolution.js
files._note: run.js seam: candidate gathering + scoring orchestration.

files.name: assertions.js
files._note: run.js seam: step assertion verification.

files.name: locators.js
files._note: run.js seam: locator strategy construction.

files.name: handlers.js
files._note: run.js seam: per-action-type step handlers.

files.name: cascade.js
files._note: run.js seam: recovery cascade orchestration.

files.name: uploads.js
files._note: run.js seam: file-upload handling.

files.name: retry_budget.js
files._note: run.js seam: per-skill retry budget.

files.name: step_utils.js
files._note: Shared step-shape helpers (asObject/asArray/unique).

files.name: marker_span.js
files._note: Marker-block span helpers shared by config_edit paths; dual-shipped with host/config_edit_toml.js which reaches it through __hostRequire.

files.name: durable_context.js
files._note: sync.js -> durable_context.js -> config_edit.js/mcp_hosts.js — all must ship here, not just be bundled into the host exe, since sync.js loads them from disk at runtime. Missing here means every sync silently fails to update discoverability files.

files.name: sync_errors.js
files._note: server.js requires this directly (not caught by any try/catch) — omitting it hard-crashes on load with "Cannot find module './sync_errors'".
